The '''Chadran disaster''' occurred<ref name="GG1" /> in [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]], when undersea [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] triggered a "[[death wave]]" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]]. Massive tidal waves swept across the world, killing hundreds of thousands of [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]]<ref name="EGTAS" /> and destroying much of the Chadrian civilization.<ref name="GG1" />
